NewsArticle.Title: Server Maintenance
NewsArticle.Content: - 11.11 04:52 PST Dark Ages servers shut down for server operations maintenance. At that time, a client would receive the message "Can't connect to the server at this time" Dark Ages servers are fine at this time. If the "Can't connect..." message is seen, please [check your connection.](http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm)
